ms.report:
Brief
This milestone delivers the Preorder Launchpad: an EffectStream application built on top of the campaign contracts of Milestone 1. 
It lets a creator create and end campaigns, lets anyone browse every ongoing presale and its catalog, lets buyers contribute by paying on-chain, and shows each wallet its own contributions and balances. All state is projected from on-chain events by a single EffectStream node. The headline improvement is on Cardano: creating a campaign is now a clone-and-publish step, and the Cardano sync is fast because it streams blocks through Dolos over UTxORPC instead of running a heavy full node.

ms.report:
BRIEF
The NFT presale template built across the earlier milestones established the foundation: contracts for EVM and Cardano L1, a sync layer, a full storefront UI, and direct Cardano L1 payment. This milestone extends that foundation as the digital asset market evolves. The way assets are sold and traded has changed, and this milestone upgrades the settlement layer to match: a commitment-based presale system that settles on Midnight - a Cardano Partner Chain where all blocks are validated by Cardano SPOs - using Cardano-native assets.
The core mechanic: a creator deploys a presale contract and sets a target. Buyers commit to purchase - but the commitment only takes effect once the total target is reached. Until the threshold is hit, committed tokens are not locked. A buyer can hold open commitments across multiple presales simultaneously with the same funds, because the system is backed by Zero Knowledge ZSwaps. The ZSwap proof demonstrates a buyer can cover their commitment without freezing the tokens; settlement only happens when the target is met.
The settlement layer runs on Midnight, a Cardano partner chain where all blocks are validated by Cardano SPOs - the same node operators who secure the Cardano network. The presale contracts accept only USDM, the first bridged asset from Cardano onto Midnight. When buyers commit, they move Cardano-native value. When a presale closes, assets can flow back: the Cardano-to-Midnight bridge carries assets in both directions, so a completed presale can settle directly into Cardano wallets.
The deliverables from earlier milestones (the Preorder template, the Aiken on-chain validator, the UTxORPC sync layer) are all bridgeable into and out of this commitment settlement layer, giving prior work a path forward as the ecosystem matures.

BRIEF
This is the Project Close Report for Catalyst proposal 1000085, "Extend NFT sale and drop tools to support dropping more complex assets as required for on-chain games", delivered across milestones M1 to M5. The project built a full presale and drop toolkit on Cardano: EVM and Cardano Aiken contracts for campaign creation and payment, an EffectStream sync layer using Dolos over UTxORPC, a full-design-system storefront UI, direct Cardano L1 payment from standard Cardano wallets (Lace, Eternl, Nami, NuFi), NFT ownership verification, and a multi-chain cart. The fifth milestone extended the settlement layer to Midnight - a Cardano Partner Chain where all blocks are validated by Cardano SPOs - delivering a commitment-based presale using USDM, the first Cardano-bridged asset on Midnight, with ZSwap zero-knowledge proofs so buyers can commit across multiple campaigns without locking funds.
